title: Quadratic equations: practice set
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: Which of these is a root of x² − 5x − 14 = 0?
What is the sum of the roots of 2x² − 9x + 4 = 0?
What is the product of the roots of 3x² + 5x − 12 = 0?
For what value of k does x² − 8x + k = 0 have two equal roots?
If α and β are the roots of x² − 5x + 3 = 0, find α² + β².
What is the minimum value of x² − 6x + 13 for real x?
The length of a rectangle is 3 m more than its breadth, and its area is 70 square metres. What is its perimeter in metres?
If α and β are the roots of x² − 6x + 4 = 0, find the value of α/β + β/α.
For how many integer values of k does x² + kx + 16 = 0 have no real roots?
